comments.author: Mattdokn
comments.body_html:
Thank you for reporting this! I had fixed this issue in 3.11 but when moving to 4.0 I couldn’t figure out how to do it the same way.

I’ve come up with a solution but it requires you to change “SPT/SPT_Data/configs/locale.json”. Update your gameLocale field to reflect the language you’re using and the mod will use that instead of english!

I’ll be posting the update momentarily.
